extracted.intended_audience: participants and members of the public in FERC proceedings (potential intervenors, protesters, applicants, landowners, tribal members, EJ communities)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural instructions and requirements for filing protests or motions to intervene in a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket (here, ER24-2602-000) regarding a market-based rate application that requests blanket Section 204 authorization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blanket Section 204 authorization request
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant's market-based rate application includes a request for blanket authorization, under 18 CFR part 34, of future issuances of securities and assumptions of liability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice specifically identifies the request for blanket authorization under 18 CFR part 34 as the subject for which protests may be filed. (No further substantive guidance on the merits is provided in this notice.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing location and governing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person desiring to intervene or to protest should file with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, 888 First Street NE, Washington, DC 20426, in accordance with Rules 211 and 214 of the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure (18 CFR 385.211 and 385.214).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow Rules 211 and 214 for timely intervention/protest; use the stated physical filing address if submitting paper pleadings. The notice ties required procedural compliance to those Rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service requirement on the Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone filing a motion to intervene or protest must serve a copy of that document on the Applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When filing a protest or motion to intervene, ensure a copy is served on the applicant (Fillmore County Solar Project, LLC) per the notice; electronic filing procedures may facilitate service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protest filing deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The deadline for filing protests with regard to the applicant's request for blanket authorization under 18 CFR part 34 is August 19, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protests submitted after this date may be untimely; the deadline is specific to the blanket authorization request identified in this supplemental notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing encouraged; eRegistration required for eFilers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission encourages electronic submission of protests and interventions in lieu of paper, using the FERC Online links at http://www.ferc.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Persons with internet access who will eFile a document and/or be listed as a contact for an intervenor must create and validate an eRegistration account using the eRegistration link. Select the eFiling link to log on and submit the intervention or protests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative paper filing and hand-delivery procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons unable to file electronically may mail similar pleadings to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, 888 First Street NE, Washington, DC 20426. Hand delivered submissions in docketed proceedings should be delivered to Health and Human Services, 12225 Wilkins Avenue, Rockville, Maryland 20852.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice provides mailing and hand-delivery options for those who cannot eFile; note the hand-delivery address as printed in the notice (appears to be an agency-specific or boilerplate location).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing the full text via eLibrary
rubrics_metrics.description: The full text of this document is available on eLibrary in PDF and Microsoft Word format for viewing, printing, and/or downloading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To access this document in eLibrary, type the docket number excluding the last three digits of this document in the docket number field. The Commission's Home Page provides eLibrary links.

rubrics_metrics.name: User assistance contacts for eLibrary and filings
rubrics_metrics.description: User assistance is available for eLibrary and the Commission's website during normal business hours from FERC Online Support at 202-502-6652 (toll free 1-866-208-3676) or email ferconlinesupport@ferc.gov, or the Public Reference Room at (202) 502-8371, TTY (202) 502-8659; Public Reference Room email: public.referenceroom@ferc.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these contacts for help accessing documents, eFiling, or locating materials in eLibrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Public Participation (OPP) assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission's Office of Public Participation supports meaningful public engagement and participation in Commission proceedings and can help members of the public (including landowners, environmental justice communities, Tribal members) access information and navigate Commission processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For public inquiries and assistance with making filings such as interventions, comments, or requests for rehearing, contact OPP at (202) 502-6595 or OPP@ferc.gov.
